info.name: FlightAssistant API
info.description:
Complete endpoint collection for the FlightAssistant backend (local dev).

Setup:
1. docker compose up -d
2. dotnet run --project FlightAssistant.API
3. Set collection variables: baseUrl, token (user B2C JWT), adminToken (JWT with admin role).

Default auth = Bearer {{token}}. Public endpoints are noauth; the Admin folder uses {{adminToken}}.
Replace the {{...Id}} path variables with real ids captured from list/create responses.

request.description: Always 200 while the process runs. No auth.
Only provided fields are updated. nationality = passport country.
programId/tierId are ints from GET /loyalty/programs. Returns 201 { id }.
Lounges annotated with eligibility from the traveler's memberships.
ISO alpha-2 uppercase codes. Sherpa-backed, cached. Rate limited 30/60s.
